item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q014_paper_example_reclassification_pa1492","answer":"In SCOP 1.69, PA1492 (d1t1ja_) and nucleoside 2-deoxyribosyltransferase (d1f8ya_) were placed in the same general fold but in separate superfamilies, so SCOP asserted structural similarity without probable common ancestry.
